title: DMHO Kakinada Notification 2026 - Apply Offline for 29 ASHA Worker Posts
description: Office of the District Medical & Health Officer, Kakinada  (DMHO Kakinada), has issued an official notification for the recruitment of 29 ASHA Worker Jobs. Candidates who have passed 10th can use this chance and apply for the DMHO Kakinada Notification 2026 . Here we have included the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts.
